_comment: The shared hotkey table (wiki/Design-Language.md, Hotkeys; user decision 2026-10-21): one key per action on every screen, and one action per key. Every hotkey the mod adds is listed here (shift+m and shift+j are reserved for the pages; split from the 1440p UI mod on 2026-10-21, whose screens keep their own table) under its action as file:button; the keys vanilla gives its own buttons stay as they are and are not listed. A new hotkey reuses the key of its action, or adds an action with a free shift+letter. tests/ScreenInvariants.Tests.ps1 checks the files against this table.

actions.action: Fold or open a manager page
